NCCL-1 : Aggregated Collectives
Requirements

Project Context and Purpose

NCCL provides fast communication for parallel applications.

NVbugs / Jira Tickets

NVBug 1983062

Jira NCCL-372

User Experience

N/A

Assumptions, constraints and dependencies

None.

Use Cases

Improve DL framework performance when using multiple GPUs.

Functional Requirements

Provide a way for DL frameworks to define NCCL operations to be aggregated, to achieve better performance.

System Requirements

None.

Interface Requirements

New verbs can be added to provide this functionality, or current verbs behavior can be extended.

KPI Requirements

Improve the time per NCCL operation by a significant factor.

Platform Requirements

N/A

Security Requirements

NCCL is a user library and benefits from the user-mode security.

Legal and Standards Requirements

N/A

Telemetry Requirements

N/A

Backward Compatibility Requirements

Changes do not need to be backward compatible.

N/A
